headline: Recommendation to approve Main Street bike lane demonstration memorandum with Bicycle Coalition of Maine goes to council.
summary: Members discussed a proposed Main Street bike lane demonstration west of Elm Street next summer, with Bicycle Coalition of Maine. A motion to recommend that council approve the memorandum passed. Concerns raised included cost, paint, parking, and road damage from bolted speed bumps.
decisions: Recommended that council approve the Main Street bike lane demonstration memorandum with Bicycle Coalition of Maine. The motion passed; no vote count was given.
discussion: Main Street bike lane demonstration: Members asked that the no-cost language in the agreement be confirmed, and raised concerns about cost, paint, parking, and road damage from bolted speed bumps.

Cherry Lane parking: Members discussed removing about 140 feet of parking on the odd-numbered side near Elm Street after a backing-out crash. They said a written order is needed and that they would like to view the site first.

Parkview Court parking: Members discussed adding parking on one side of a street serving 40 units. Fire truck access and parking demand were raised, and a request was made for members to visit the site.
Super Sub Shop parking: Members discussed two no-parking spaces set aside for food trucks at Jefferson and Franklin. The matter was sent to attorneys, and it may need planning board review.

decision_evidence.quote: Can I move that we approve it then? Any discussion? ... Seeing none, all in favor of sending this to council for with a recommendation to approve. Opposed? When in opposition, motion passes.

decision_titles: Main Street bike lane demonstration memorandum
